messages:
Maria (PM): Quick heads-up — need to align on access-event tracing for EU tenants. Major customer asks: (1) pseudonymize PII in audit events, (2) ensure exports are GDPR-friendly, and (3) have clear launch gates. Can we do a short sync today?
Ajay (Eng): Yep. Two immediate questions: are we doing pseudonymization at ingest or on-query? Ingest is simpler for analytics, on-query is better for revocation.
Sana (Security): Prefer ingest pseudonymization with per-tenant salt stored in KMS. That avoids retaining raw identifiers in any hot store. Need threat model review though.
Ethan (SRE): Ops concern: if we pseudonymize at ingest we lose ability to map back for debugging. We should keep an HMAC-with-key approach where key material is rotate-able and access-controlled.
Maria (PM): Good point. Customer ask includes occasional legal export (court order). We need a controlled unmasking path with audit. Legal-bot: note: unmasking should be a documented, auditable process tied to legal requests — track who triggered it and why.
Ajay (Eng): Proposal: ingest pipeline runs pseudonymization step producing event.user_hash = HMAC_SHA256(tenant_salt, user_id) and store raw user_id in a separate encrypted blobstore accessible only via a keystore-approved unmask service. Sample snippet:```// pseudonymize
const user_hash = hmac_sha256(tenantSalt, userId);
emit({ts, event, user_hash});
// store raw -> encrypted_blobstore.put(tenantId, event_id, encrypt(userId, unmaskKey))
```
Sana (Security): +1 but require that unmaskKey is stored in customer KMS for BYOK customers. For hosted customers, keys in our HSM with strict RBAC and 2-person approval workflow.
Ethan (SRE): Can we add an event flag for whether raw was persisted? We should be able to index which events have a raw blob so we don't accidentally query unmapped data. Also retention TTL of raw blobs needs to be configurable per-customer.
Maria (PM): Draft acceptance criteria for GA: 1) ingestion pseudonymization implemented, 2) unmask path with audit logs and RBAC, 3) per-tenant retention config (min/max), 4) automated checks that prevent raw identifiers from being returned in search APIs, 5) docs and legal sign-off.
Ajay (Eng): Implementation tasks: schema add event.user_hash, new encrypted_blobstore service + unmask endpoint, pipeline transforms, e2e tests (including canary that verifies no raw leaks). ETA: rough 3 sprints if we prioritize.
Sana (Security): Risk checklist: key rotation, KMS integration matrix (AWS/GCP/Azure), export controls (no cross-border raw exports for EU without legal basis), and telemetry to detect unmask abuse.
Legal-bot: For exports: require export policy flag per-tenant and a manual approval step for EU->non-EU shipment. Keep records for 7 years for high-sensitivity requests.
Maria (PM): Launch gates proposal: - Security review sign-off, - Legal export workflow in place, - BYOK path validated for at least AWS KMS, - QA test coverage for no-PII leaks, - Pilot with 3 customers. If all green, roll to GA.
Ethan (SRE): Ops rollout plan: canary region + tenant opt-in via feature flag. Monitor error rates + query correctness. Add SLA rollback if unmask service latency > 500ms for >5% of requests.
Ajay (Eng): One more decision: do we pseudonymize other identifiers (session_id, ip) or only user_id? I suggest we pseudonymize ip for EU tenants and store coarse geo separately.
Sana (Security): Agree on ip pseudonymization for EU. Also add retention policy: raw blobs must auto-delete after tenant-configured TTL; default 30 days for hosted EU tenants.
Maria (PM): Action items: Ajay -> tech design doc (due EOD tomorrow), Sana -> threat model + KMS matrix (due +3 days), Ethan -> rollout playbook + alert thresholds (due +4 days), Legal-bot -> export policy template (due +5 days). I'll schedule a 30-min sync after docs are in.
Ajay (Eng): I'll include sample curl for unmask request and example audit entry. Quick note: need product decision on whether unmask requires 2 approvals for enterprise SKUs.
Maria (PM): We should gate 2-approval on contract tier (enterprise only). Call it out in design doc.
Sana (Security): :thumbsup: Also include automated log sampling to detect accidental raw leakage during canary.
Ethan (SRE): I'll add runbook steps for emergency revoke of unmask keys.
Maria (PM): Thanks all — will follow up with meeting invite once docs land. :pray:
